instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Edit an image locally", and give it the brief and the fields its input names.
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:edit-local-image and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read the picture file it kept in your files. If the mflux app is not on this Mac, the run says so and nothing is made.
